guides.favoredWhen: Urgot wins by buffering the stun, timing the execute past the shield, and outscaling; Pantheon wins early poke and roam punishment.

keyTips.text: Sidestep Q and give up CS to survive the lane. His poke pattern is the whole early game, so concede farm rather than health.
keyTips.heading: Survive first

keyTips.text: E-buffer his W stun. Fire E as he commits and the stun never completes, turning his engage into your return trade.
keyTips.heading: Stun buffer

keyTips.text: Time the R recast for after his shield ends. The shield blocks the execute pull, so wait it out and recast into the opening.
keyTips.heading: Execute timing

tips.text: Read his empowered bar before trading. A charged bar means a stronger next ability, so give ground until it discharges on the wave.
tips.heading: Bar watch

tips.text: Reposition when he flips you. If his E turns you, face E back toward him so the return trade starts instantly.
tips.heading: Flip answer

tips.text: Ping his global R and push while he leaves. Every roam costs him a wave, so shove hard and punish the lost farm.
tips.heading: Roam punish

tips.text: Use E to get behind the shield when he raises it. The reposition beats the block and sets up knees from the safe side.
tips.heading: Shield answer

tips.text: Extend the game and outscale. Your 1v1 and teamfight both grow past his, so refuse early coinflips and win on items.
tips.heading: Outscale plan

tips.text: Execute only into shield downtime. Hold the recast until the block fades, and never spend the pull into a raised shield.
tips.heading: Shield discipline

sources.author: procatking
sources.rankClaim: Emerald (badge, no title claim) · Pantheon main

guides.favoredWhen: Urgot wins by buffering the dash, denying W-mark heals, and outscaling; Volibear wins early all-ins and tower dives.

keyTips.text: Walk out of his E circle. The marked zone is the whole engage, so leave it on sight and re-enter only after it fades.
keyTips.heading: E escape

keyTips.text: E-buffer his Q stun. Time E for the dash impact and the stun never lands, which also avoids the E he places on the landing spot.
keyTips.heading: Stun buffer

keyTips.text: Disengage after his W marks you. The second hit heals him, so break contact at the mark and deny the bonus damage and healing.
keyTips.heading: Mark discipline

tips.text: Poke him before he reaches you. He wants to avoid early poke, so zone with Q and knees rather than letting him walk into range free.
tips.heading: Early zone

tips.text: Trade around his W cooldown. Engage into the spent W and leave at the mark, keeping every exchange on your terms.
tips.heading: W windows

tips.text: Save E and R control until he lands from his ultimate. He cannot be disabled mid-leap, so hold everything for the landing moment.
tips.heading: Landing answer

tips.text: Extend the game because he falls off hard. Every completed item widens your gap, so refuse coinflips and scale past him.
tips.heading: Outscale plan

tips.text: Respect the tower dive when low. His R disables the tower for him, so recall early or concede CS rather than dying under your own turret.
tips.heading: Dive respect

tips.text: Force fights after his falloff point. Once your items land, take every duel and convert the 1v1 edge into objectives.
tips.heading: Press the edge

itemization.text: Expect Warden's Mail against your repeated damage. Trade with knees and E rather than autos into the armor, and keep the poke pattern going.

guides.favoredWhen: Urgot wins by baiting Riposte, walling her R, and forcing teamfights; Fiora wins extended duels if Riposte answers E and she reaches her later spike.

keyTips.text: Never E from max range while Riposte is ready. Bait the parry with a short E near her, or catch Q as she steps in for a vital.
keyTips.heading: E discipline

keyTips.text: Trade autos after Q poke unless her wave is too large. The Q-plus-autos pattern is your safe exchange; a big wave turns it against you.
keyTips.heading: Safe exchange

keyTips.text: Give her no free windows. She trades after your missed Q, spent passive shots, or an exposed vital, so Q with intent and keep vitals turned away.
keyTips.heading: Deny windows

tips.text: Meet her vital walk-ups with Q and autos. When a vital faces her and she steps in, answer immediately; back off once her wave grows too large to contest.
tips.heading: Vital answers

tips.text: Do not E predictably while she holds Q and Riposte. She dashes into your E and parries the landing, so vary the timing or hold it until she commits elsewhere.
tips.heading: E patience

tips.text: Press before her Ravenous turn. Bramble stalls your damage for a window, then she returns stronger, so force the lane while the stall is still buying time.
tips.heading: Spike race

tips.text: Respect her two-to-three-item parity. If even, she matches you in that window before you pull ahead again, so take duels from advantage, not from even.
tips.heading: Parity respect

tips.text: Wall her ultimate. Stand near a wall during R so the final vital stays denied and her full proc never completes.
tips.heading: Beat the duel

tips.text: If she lands W, keep W firing. Your attack rate is not slowed by the parry, so the locked-on exchange still favors you.
tips.heading: Fire through

tips.text: Force teamfights over duels. Your 5v5 is much stronger than hers, so convert pressure into grouped fights instead of offering the isolated duel she wants.
tips.heading: Teamfight plan

sources.author: TTVJustSad42
sources.rankClaim: Rank 1 Challenger (title, no badge) · Fiora main

guides.favoredWhen: Urgot wins by timing E on Hookshot landings and forcing teamfights; Camille wins even 1v1s where her ultimate dodges the execute.

keyTips.text: Fire E as she lands from Hookshot, never mid-air. The landing is the hittable moment; the airborne cast always misses the window.
keyTips.heading: E timing

keyTips.text: Cast R during the E stun so she cannot dodge it. The chained control locks out her ultimate answer and guarantees the execute setup.
keyTips.heading: Execute chain

keyTips.text: Kite her passive-shield auto and position W between poke and farm. Make her choose: contest the poke and concede farm, or farm into your knees.
keyTips.heading: Shield denial

tips.text: Track her jungler every wave. Her gank setup is among the strongest top, so ward the lane and trade only with vision before committing.
tips.heading: Gank respect

tips.text: Keep trades short. She deals Q damage then leaves, so answer the Q at its edge and refuse the chase into her second rotation.
tips.heading: Short trades

tips.text: Force her ultimate out before executing. Poke it free with E-stun combos, since she saves R to dodge the execute pull.
tips.heading: Bait the dodge

tips.text: Step inside her Q edge when she commits. She enters the inner ring to deny the edge, so hold the cast and W her at close range instead.
tips.heading: Inner answer

tips.text: Force teamfights over even 1v1s. Her scaling wins the isolated duel, while your knees decide grouped fights, so convert pressure into 5v5s.
tips.heading: Teamfight plan

tips.text: Punish her roams with plates and vision. She must leave to find odd fights, so take the tower gold and track every departure.
tips.heading: Roam punish

guides.favoredWhen: Urgot wins by buffering his knockups and spiking on Black Cleaver; Ornn wins early composure and brittle combos.

keyTips.text: Use E to cancel or buffer his E. Fire as he commits and the knockup never completes, turning his engage into your trade.
keyTips.heading: E answer

keyTips.text: Never stand in line with low-health minions. He fires Q through them to reach you, so offset from the wave's dying edge.
keyTips.heading: Positioning

keyTips.text: Turn the lane at level 9 with Black Cleaver. The spike plus ranks flips every exchange, so survive to it and press after.
keyTips.heading: Spike turn

tips.text: Press before his armor components land. He plays safely waiting for them, so the pre-component window is your only free pressure.
tips.heading: Early window

tips.text: Respect Aery poke without conceding the wave. Take short contacts and answer with knees rather than brawling into brittle procs.
tips.heading: Poke respect

tips.text: E-buffer the knockups from his E and the second hit of R. Both telegraphs lose to a timed E, so hold it for the cast animations.
tips.heading: Buffer plan

tips.text: Keep firing into Frozen Heart. Its attack-speed slow does not touch your W rate, so his rush item buys him nothing against locked-on knees.
tips.heading: Ignore Heart

tips.text: Duel after Black Cleaver completes. The armor-shred turn makes extended trades yours, so force them once the item is done.
tips.heading: Cleaver duels

tips.text: Close before his teamfight value matters. Your edge is the 1v1 spike, so end the lane phase ahead rather than matching his utility scaling.
tips.heading: Close early

itemization.text: Build Black Cleaver as the matchup spike. It answers his armor stacking and turns level 9 into your lane-winning window.

sources.author: Eve0030
sources.rankClaim: Master OTP (title and badge) · Ornn main

keyTips.text: Treat levels one to three as pressure, not a mandate to brawl: Urgot scales into a midgame champion, so zone and build toward the level-nine spike instead of forcing every fight.
Start E, landing a basic attack before it when surprising an opponent, and align an early E to hit the first three melee minions plus the opponent when they stand low.
Reach level nine with Black Cleaver complete: max-rank W then stays active without mana cost or cooldown until toggled off, and the sustained damage jumps sharply.

tips.text: At levels one and two, use passive and E pressure to zone and slow-push; ward once the wave is fully under the enemy tower, ideally before the three-minute gank window.
At levels four and five, take safe autos when the opponent farms and use E only when they step into range, waiting for its return rather than forcing trades.
Plan an early Cull when a recall comes around levels four and five, including a roughly four-hundred-fifty gold recall timing.
Play the level-eleven and level-thirteen passive shotgun cooldowns by circling targets so repeated attacks land harder as Urgot rounds them.
Around level thirteen, press the advantage with side-lane fights, then rotate or Teleport to teamfights; this midgame window is Urgot's strongest phase.
On turrets or neutral objectives, weave one basic attack after every three W hits for extra damage.
In a teamfight, follow allied crowd control with R, using Flash near the end of the pull to spread the ultimate fear across nearby enemies.
Split-push while waiting for Flash or Teleport; with Teleport ready, pressure the side opposite a major objective and join when the fight starts.
Build through the level-nine W toggle and Black Cleaver spike, then use the level-eleven to thirteen passive cooldowns to win extended fights and convert them into objectives.
Favor teamfights where Urgot follows allied engage and creates an area fear, or flank to expose a backline target for E into R.
Spend the lead before roughly thirty to thirty-five minutes: Urgot's relative strength tapers after that point, so secure map pressure during the midgame peak.

itemization.text: Run Press the Attack with Triumph, Legend: Bloodline, and Cut Down plus Second Wind and Overgrowth, with Flash and Ignite and a Doran's Blade start.

Build Black Cleaver, Boots of Swiftness, Sterak's Gage, Dead Man's Plate, Force of Nature, and Overlord's Bloodmail, maxing W first; keep Plated Steelcaps, Gluttonous Greaves, Doran's Shield, Kaenic Rookern, Randuin's Omen, Thornmail, Chempunk Chainsword, Jak'Sho, and Spear of Shojin as situational picks.
